header: The look of the calculators and converters, in the family of the management windows (employee, PAX): glass cards on a soft gradient with two blurred lights, gradient icon tiles, rounded-3xl frames, inputs with an inner shadow and a coloured focus ring. Here are the pieces that have a life of their own:
- ToolShell: the frame of a card, with its tone, its Instant pill and an entrance;
- Elastic: a box whose height follows its content with a spring (so a long unit name inflates the box and a short one lets it deflate, smoothly);
- ToolSelect: the dropdown, with a proper chevron, the WHOLE of a long option visible (it wraps), search when the list is long, the keyboard, and an animated list;
- fitSize: the size of a big number, shrinking as it gets longer so that it is always seen whole.
Nothing here knows any sum, and nothing is stored or sent. I use only Tailwind sizes that the modal's scale sheet (omniScale.css) knows, so all of it follows the modal's text scale.

symbols.name: filterOptions
symbols.sig: export function filterOptions(options: SelectOption[], query: string): SelectOption[]
doc: The options that match what was typed in the search box (every typed word must be in the label).

symbols.name: placeList
symbols.sig: export function placeList(buttonTop: number, buttonBottom: number, viewportHeight: number, natural: number, margin = 12, gap = 8): { up: boolean; room: number }
doc: Where a dropdown list goes. I measure BEFORE it opens: the room below the button against the height the list normally has; below is the first choice; if it does not fit there but fits above, I use above; if it fits on neither side it takes the larger side and its list scrolls inside the room there is. It is drawn over everything (a portal on the page, position fixed), so no window, bar or scrolling area it sits in can hide any part of it.

symbols.name: naturalListHeight
symbols.sig: export function naturalListHeight(rows: number, searchable: boolean): number
doc: The height a list normally has: its rows (about 2.5 rem each) and its search box, never more than 20 rem.

symbols.name: ToolSelect
symbols.sig: export function ToolSelect({ value, options, onChange, ariaLabel, id, tone = "sky", variant = "field", dark, className = "", alignRight, placeholder }: ToolSelectProps)

params.name: { value, options, onChange, ariaLabel, id, tone = "sky", variant = "field", dark, className = "", alignRight, placeholder }

doc: The dropdown of the tools. The button shows the WHOLE of the chosen option (a long name wraps onto more lines and the box inflates and deflates with a spring); the chevron turns over when the list opens; the list animates in, scrolls when long, can be searched (more than eight options), and is driven from the keyboard (arrows, Home, End, Enter, Escape, type to search). I made Escape close only the list, never the search window around it.
